scope: Three fresh processes per workload size; eight native operation iterations per process. No native terminal/compositor presentation is measured.

Native drivers use identical code and Rust 1.99.1 -C opt-level=3 against each optimized application library and exact Cargo runtime dependencies, avoiding rebuilding unchanged full benchmark suites for the baseline.

Read-state fixture: 2,000/13,000 articles and 46 distinct broad FTS smart queries; simulated active Reader time, real WAL writes, counts, undo and durable state checks. Fixture setup and undo excluded from operation timers.

Image fixture: two obsolete 800/3,000-path SVG sources replaced by a visible blue source, real offline cache and the existing two download lanes/shared decoder; exact visible blue cell checks. Source setup excluded.

Server fixture: real loopback HTTP, 8/16 feeds, one discovery request and one empty entry page per feed. CLI startup and isolated database/config initialization included. Token and data are synthetic.
Already-started image encoding is cooperative; an HTTP call waiting for response headers retains its existing six-second deadline. No transport-level abort is claimed.
